comment: The package scripts and test directories a managed project MUST provide because the canonical
workflows in starter/ci/workflows/ run them (R3-05). This file is delivered to a generated
project as ops/release/package-scripts.json and is checked by ops/release/check-project-scripts.mjs
in the workflow-validation gate, so a project that is missing any of them fails its own CI with
the exact list instead of failing eight gates with confusing resolution errors.
R8REL-02: "command" is the PINNED BODY of the script, not a suggestion. The canonical workflows
run `pnpm run <name>`, and what that name RUNS lives in package.json - a file no control pinned,
tested or reviewed. One word ("smoke:production": "true") therefore made the pre-promotion smoke
gate vacuous while all three delivered controls stayed green, and the same edit silenced five of
the thirteen required gates (lint, typecheck, build, migrations, operational_readiness), which
are defined ENTIRELY in package.json. check-project-scripts.mjs now compares each required
script's body against "command" and refuses a divergence, and both branch-protection plans put
package.json under code-owner review. A project that must implement a gate differently changes
this declaration in the standard, which is a reviewed diff in a covered path - not a word in its
own package.json.
"suggested" stays the string starter/create-project.mjs writes when a script is absent, and
ops/release/release.test.mjs asserts it is IDENTICAL to "command" for every entry, so the
generator can never produce a project that fails its own pin.
CLOSED (W03f): starter/template/package.json declares every script, starter/template/ops/ holds
the files they run and starter/template/tests/ holds the six directories, and
starter/create-project.mjs merges this declaration into the generated package.json. The starter
lane guards it with starter/tests/workflow-contract.test.mjs (parses the canonical workflows)
and starter/tests/ops-scripts.test.mjs (runs every script).

lint.purpose: static lint of the whole project; the lint gate

typecheck.purpose: TypeScript project check without emit; the typecheck gate

build.purpose: ordinary application build; the build gate

check:standard.purpose: operational readiness check against the launch standard; the operational_readiness gate

migration:check.purpose: verify the migration set against the target schema without applying it; the migrations gate

migration:apply.purpose: apply migrations to one environment schema; runs only in the production environment job

build:production.purpose: production-configured build without domain assignment; also creates the candidate deployment

smoke:production.purpose: bounded read-only smoke check against the production deployment before promotion

promote:production.purpose: promote the verified build to production; the single production promotion owner

health:production.purpose: bounded post-promotion health check writing health.json

rollback:app.purpose: application-only rollback to a known good deployment; never restores a database
